mapper.select: SELECT `id`, `guid`, `user_identifier` AS userIdentifier, `bucket_name` AS bucketName, `volume_guid` AS volumeGuid, `ext_config` AS extConfig, `create_time` AS createTime, `update_time` AS updateTime FROM `hydra_uofs_bucket` WHERE `guid` = #{guid}

SELECT `id`, `guid`, `user_identifier` AS userIdentifier, `bucket_name` AS bucketName, `volume_guid` AS volumeGuid, `ext_config` AS extConfig, `create_time` AS createTime, `update_time` AS updateTime FROM `hydra_uofs_bucket` WHERE `user_identifier` = #{userIdentifier} AND `bucket_name` = #{bucketName}

SELECT `id`, `guid`, `user_identifier` AS userIdentifier, `bucket_name` AS bucketName, `volume_guid` AS volumeGuid, `ext_config` AS extConfig, `create_time` AS createTime, `update_time` AS updateTime FROM `hydra_uofs_bucket` ORDER BY `create_time` DESC
